en.title: Count Binary Substrings
en.description:
Count substrings consisting of two adjacent equal-length runs of consecutive 0s and 1s, counting each position separately.

See "Input" for the standard input/output conventions and constraints added by this site.
en.output: Output the number of valid substrings.
en.explanation: Compress runs of consecutive characters; each pair of adjacent runs contributes the smaller of their lengths.
